description: Serie finale ballons Telstar — USA (1/47), gabarit v6 valide : seed exact + referenceImages FLUX.2, liseré aux couleurs du pays.

ai_generation.positive_prompt: Transform this exact image into a photographic macro shot of a circular embroidered iron-on patch on dark charcoal felt, keeping the EXACT same composition, panel layout, flag placement and flag details: a classic 32-panel Telstar soccer ball whose pentagon panels each carry the flag of the United States of America — thirteen red and white horizontal stripes with a navy blue canton filled with small white stars in the upper left — while every hexagon panel stays plain cream-white satin stitch with no pattern. Keep every pentagon and hexagon exactly where it is in the source image and keep each American flag accurate: stripes, canton and stars embroidered in fine thread. Render all panel seams as clean black chain-stitch embroidery following the curvature of the sphere, give the ball gentle three-dimensional spherical shading so it reads as a round stitched ball, and turn the colored rings into a thick twisted navy blue and red rope border around the circular patch edge. Dense embroidery texture everywhere: individual thread strands clearly visible, raised satin-stitch relief catching soft studio light, subtle textile sheen. The whole circular patch fully visible with a clear margin of dark felt all around. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark.
